name: Stamp
description: A verdict seal slammed down at `at`: overshoots, shakes, settles, tilted. a word or two reads best (APPROVED, SOLD OUT, 真香); the seal is sized to the clip box, so give it a square-ish box over the thing it judges.

text.description: the verdict; two or more words (or 4+ CJK characters) stack on two lines

at.description: Time it lands: "line:14+0.4", "clip:st" or seconds from the clip start. Nothing shows before it. Default: 0.2 s into the clip

double.description: a double border, like an official seal

color.description: theme token (accent, bad, good, gold, ink) or CSS

ground.description: what it sits on: light inks into the paper (multiply), dark gets a faint plate so it stays visible
